branch.new_demand: Use probability to design and check fair decisions.
branch.builds_on: Builds on FORWARD 1: from comparing strategies, the student turns to designing decisions that are fair.

questions.domain: Statistics & Probability: Using Probability to Make Decisions
questions.skill: Make fair decisions with probability
questions.standard_level: Probability & Statistics. Common Core groups high-school standards by category, not by course; this bank places this one in Probability & Statistics, following the Common Core traditional pathway (Appendix A) except where engine/hs_courses.py says otherwise.
questions.prompt: Four friends want to decide fairly with one die who gets a ticket. Which method is fair?
questions.prompt_markup: Four friends want to decide fairly with one die who gets a ticket. Which method is fair?

choices.text: Assign 1-4 to the friends and reroll a 5 or 6.
Assign 1-4 and give 5 and 6 to the first friend.
Give the ticket to whoever guesses the roll.
Give 1-3 to one friend and 4-6 to the other three.

questions.correct_answer: Assign 1-4 to the friends and reroll a 5 or 6.
questions.grading_note: Rerolling keeps 1/4 each; the others favor someone or do not use chance fairly.
